253d28f6.text:
A Report on the State of wendigo in the caves near Kharanos

Written by Mountaineer Gretchen based on the findings of Mountaineer Cornelius

The wendigo rarely leave their caves, but there have been reports that they have attacked civilians around nearby settlements such as Kharanos and Brewnall Village. They seem to be growing increasingly agitated as they search for food. We have now lost one of our own to the efforts of containing them. While the full removal of these beasts is impractical, the mountaineers request
253d28f6.title: Senir's Report

2d0045b9.text:
A Report on the State of the Frostmane Trolls in the General Area of Dun Morogh

Prepared by Senir Whitebeard, Senate Special Envoy

The trolls situated in Dun Morogh are largely centralized in Frostmane Hold, a mountain cave on the western border. They have sufficient numbers to cause some concern, however, they seem more than content to stay in their cave. This is, no doubt, because they do not wish to incur the wrath of the dwarves again, and risk total extermination. Their actions can be considered territorial, if anything, and it is
2d0045b9.title: Senir's Report

782a6d8e.text:
my belief that they pose no real threat to us, so long as we do not encroach upon their territory. This may be a situation unappealing to the dwarven populace, but given the dispersal of military resources, it may be prudent to relegate the extermination of the trolls to a lower level of importance, and continue to focus on the threat posed by the troggs and the Dark Irons.

Enclosed, you will also find a copy of my brother Grelin's report on Anvilmar and another report by one of our mountaineers regarding the wendigo.

Signed,
Senir Whitebeard
782a6d8e.title: Senir's Report

10090|0e051c59.name: Belia Thundergranite
10090|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

11028|aa37b039.name: Jemma Quikswitch
11028|aa37b039.text: Well... I hate to admit it, but my sister's the one you'll have to talk to if you want to continue training. I don't know as much as she does... yet! She's standing over by the rocket car.

11029|28ea6aca.name: Trixie Quikswitch
11029|28ea6aca.text: You'll need to prove your worthiness before I go giving away my secrets! I've got just the test for you...

11145|2e8b4855.name: Myolor Sunderfury
11145|2e8b4855.text: Greetings, $N. I am Myolor Sunderfury, keeper of the Great Forge.

1231|117e1541.name: Grif Wildheart
1231|117e1541.text: Before beginning a hunt, it is wise to ask someone what you are looking for before you begin looking for it.

1374|61386298.name: Rejold Barleybrew
1374|61386298.text:
Curse that Brewers' League!  They have access to all the best ingredients, while we're stuck here grubbing for grain and hops!

I really would like to give them some bitter tasting justice...

14982|755d8f77.name: Lylandris
14982|755d8f77.text: $C, we need your assistance at Warsong Gulch.  Will you aid us in our fight against the Warsong Outriders?

15351|f54c92d6.name: Alliance Brigadier General
15351|f54c92d6.text: The war against the Horde has reached full tilt, $N.  This is a time of great need for the Alliance and it's quite necessary that all of us do our part to help.

1702|ff623593.name: Bronk Guzzlegear
1702|ff623593.text: I would train ye if I could, but ye need the services of someone a bit more... what's the word? Brainy! Look for Trixie Quickswitch in Ironforge. Tell 'er Bronk sent ye!

258098|1605f087.name: Eldrun Stormbreaker
258098|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

4256|d1bed30c.name: Golnir Bouldertoe
4256|d1bed30c.text: If you ask me, there's no greater profession than a miner.  And if you ask me, there's no greater miner than a $r!

4258|bb5f9372.name: Bengus Deepforge
4258|bb5f9372.text: I hope ye didn't come all the way to the Great Forge just to stay warm. Speak up lad, tell me what it is I can do for ye?

5115|08830bac.name: Daera Brightspear
5115|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

5115|a665cdb8.name: Daera Brightspear
5115|a665cdb8.text: Wot kin I do fer ye?

5161|6aaffb9a.name: Grimnur Stonebrand
5161|6aaffb9a.text: Yap, I can teach ye to fish.

8386-complete.name: Alliance Brigadier General
8386-complete.text: Good work, $N.  Thanks to you, our natural defenses in Ashenvale will remain intact for another day.
8386-complete.title: Fight for Warsong Gulch

8386-progress.name: Alliance Brigadier General
8386-progress.text: Don't forget the fight for Warsong Gulch is about more than just protecting trees.  It's about keeping a natural barrier between Ashenvale and the Barrens.  Do you bring any news from the battlefield, $N?
8386-progress.title: Fight for Warsong Gulch

97263-accept.name: Unknown
97263-accept.text: <Several misplaced packages have been left by the mailbox. You note that one of them is marked for delivery from Aerie Peak, to Ironforge, to Eldrun Stormbreaker. It is marked "urgent.">
97263-accept.title: Your Package Has Arrived
